summary: Sega and RGG Studio's crime-drama action-adventure/RPG franchise, covering the Kiryu saga, Kiwami remakes, Japan-only historical and PSP spinoffs, Judgment branch, Ichiban RPG era, recent gaidens, and upcoming distant prequel.
